Passwords — shown this once; channels.json keeps only their hashes:
  leads          apwn-63c6-8jv6
  Leads Meeting  es5r-svku-7tfu

Restart the server to load it. To change a password for good, put
"password": "…" in place of that channel's "password_hash".

- Without accounts the server stores no chat: somebody new gets past messages from members who share their history. With accounts, members can also keep end-to-end-encrypted copies on the server.
- Add a channel per team or topic as the project grows.
- Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.
